issues.description: Extraction assumes preexisting data/stories/{emotion} files, but the checkout has no story dataset so the documented demo cannot run.
generate-stories requires an existing manifest.json to get topics, so it cannot bootstrap the missing story dataset.
Model loading uses dtype= with transformers>=4.42, which is incompatible with older supported Transformers versions that expect torch_dtype.
The steering integration test only checks that Elo changes, not that steering direction matches correlation or improves the claimed signal.
Checked-in tiny steering results show weak/negative correlation-vs-shift behavior, contradicting the claimed causal validation.
The correlation-vs-shift output is reported with an overclaiming plot title even when the computed correlation is weak or negative.
The only story dataset test is skipped when data/stories/manifest.json is absent, so the missing critical input data does not fail tests.
Story generation performs HTTP requests without timeout, retry, or response-status handling, so failures can hang or surface unclearly.
pca_components divides by total variance without guarding zero-variance inputs, producing NaNs for degenerate neutral activations.
Neutral activation capture stacks all hidden states and concatenates them in memory, which can consume gigabytes for the real model.
all_token_activations blindly drops token position 0 as BOS, which silently removes a real token for tokenizers that do not prepend BOS.
Steering hooks depend on mutable shared self._steer_mask state, making the model wrapper non-reentrant and fragile under concurrent use.
requirements.txt mixes runtime and test dependencies by including pytest, while pyproject.toml correctly treats pytest as dev-only.
Generated egg-info metadata is present in the tree despite .gitignore excluding *.egg-info, indicating repository hygiene drift.
